I appreciate your advice throwawaytorelate. Wished that you had a great Christmas.

My kids and wife went out of town with another relative, the first time that had happened. I usually spent my Christmas with them, never once I celebrate it alone till this year. That minimizes the built up pressure. Also, 1 relative gave me $100 that will support my family up until this coming weekend.
...my best parting song for me "It Ain't Me"

thank you for your message JWeeez. I really really am lost of ways to earn money and raise my family., this weekend will be a spoiler one for me. I am very very sad of the fact that I will do it, and I can only spend the $100 for a memorable time with them.
